t: Eleven teacher co-designed lessons that use image-based AI across school subjects.
steps: Find the project home page for the ASU IMAGE STEAM curriculum.
Browse the list of 11 lessons and choose one for your subject.
Open the slides and documents in Google Drive.
Check which AI tool the lesson uses.
Ask IT whether that tool is open on student devices.
Try the lesson yourself before class.
Read the license wording on the site before you share changes.
